dim_resolution.action: scan country_code dict; resolve us_code = dict_index_of('[us]')
scan; resolve it1_id where info='countries', it2_id where info='rating'
scan; build kw_ids hash_set with {murder, murder-in-title, blood, violence} -> ~4 ids
scan; build kt_ids hash_set with {movie, episode} -> 2 ids
precompute mi_info_set as flat array of 10 (off,len) string views for memcmp

join_order.notes: EXISTS check: stop at first matching mk row per t.id; tiny set -> linear scan or 4-way branch
must find >=1 row with info_type_id==it2_id AND info<'8.5'; track MIN(info) over surviving rows
filter info_type_id==it1_id first (cheap int), then 10-literal memcmp IN-set; first match short-circuits

join_order.build: cn.country_code != us_code (dim filter precomputed as bitset over 234997 ids)
join_order.notes: no mc.note filter in Q22d -> skip note files; for each mc row check cn_country_ok[mc.company_id]; track MIN(cn.name) via cn.name offsets

data_structures.mi_info_set: flat_array of {const char*, uint32_t len}[10] sorted by length for early-out memcmp
data_structures.cn_country_ok: bitset(234997) precomputed from country_code.bin (true if code != 0 && code != us_code)
data_structures.cn_name_offsets: mmap company_name/name.off + name.dat for MIN(cn.name) string compare
data_structures.mi_idx_info: mmap movie_info_idx/info.off + info.dat for lex compare and MIN tracking
data_structures.aggregation: scalar MIN slots: cn_name_min, mi_idx_info_min, title_min (each: best (off,len) seen)

parallelism.notes: partition title.id range across 12 threads; each thread maintains local MIN triple; final reduction combines via string compare

execution_notes: Order of fact probes per surviving t row: mk (cheapest semi via tiny kw_ids) -> mi_idx (smallest fact 1.38M, also yields MIN value) -> mi (largest fact, semi-join with short-circuit) -> mc (yields MIN cn.name).
Short-circuit: as soon as any required semi-join finds zero matches, skip remaining probes for this t.
For mi_idx and mc which contribute to MIN, must iterate all matching rows (cannot short-circuit) to find local minimum, then merge with global.
Optimization: if current global MIN(cn.name) is already lexicographically <= some lower bound, we still must continue for correctness (no early termination for MIN).
Skip reading mc.note.off and mc.note.dat entirely (saves I/O vs Q22c).
HDD: sequential per-column scans dominate; offsets_only indexes give clustered movie_id ranges.
